active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Galadriel may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Light of Earendil
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. At any point during her Activation, Galadriel can use the Light of Eärendil to roll a D6. On a 3+, Galadriel counts as having Cast the Blinding Light Magical Power. This does not prevent Galadriel from attempting to Cast another Magical Power during her Activation.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Lady of Lorien
active_or_passive_rules.description: Galadriel gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: War Aspect
active_or_passive_rules.description: Enemy models within 6" of Galadriel suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they take. Additionally, Galadriel never counts as Unarmed.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "Go back to the void, from whence you came!"
active_or_passive_rules.description: Galadriel may target any enemy model with the Banishment Magical Power as if it was a Spirit model; though non-Spirit models targeted in this way gain an additional free Will Point when attempting to Resist this Magical Power. Once per game, so long as she has at least 1 Will Point remaining, Galadriel may use this special rule instead of attempting to Cast a Magical Power. If she does, then Galadriel may choose a single enemy model within 6". The chosen model immediately suffers D3 Wounds. After using this special rule, Galadriel reduces her Will Points to 0, is placed Prone, and no longer benefits from her The Lady of Lórien or War Aspect special rules (this will mean she is then Unarmed).

active_or_passive_rules.name: Sebastian
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. During a Combat, Radagast may roll an additional D6 in his Duel Roll, and may make an additional Strike if he wins the Combat. This additional D6 cannot be modified by Might, and is treated as being Strength 1 when making Strikes - roll a separate dice for Sebastian to make sure.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Master of Birds
active_or_passive_rules.description: Radagast is always assumed to have Line of Sight to anywhere on the battlefield. Additionally, friendly Eagle models within 12" of Radagast gain the Resistant to Magic special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Voice of Curunir
active_or_passive_rules.description: The range of Saruman's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6". Additionally, friendly Hero models can benefit from Saruman's Stand Fast.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Consuming Rivalry
active_or_passive_rules.description: Saruman may never benefit from a Heroic Action declared by Gandalf the Grey, nor may he be targeted by any Magical Power Cast by a friendly Gandalf the Grey.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lord of the Istari
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the beginning of each Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions Step, Saruman may choose a single enemy model within 6" and Line of Sight. The chosen model must immediately take an Intelligence Test. If the test is failed, the chosen model cannot be Activated that turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Shattered Spirit
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the start of the Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions Step, Thráin must take an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, Thráin acts normally during the turn. If the test is passed on a double (i.e., both dice show the same score) then until the end of the turn, Thráin increases his Attacks to 3, his Strength to 4, and gains the Fearless special rule. If the test is failed, then the opposing player controls Thráin as if he was one of their models, and will Activate Thráin during their own Activation Phase. Though he is being controlled by the opposing player, Thráin cannot be targeted with shooting attacks, Magical Powers or special rules that affect enemy models. Additionally, if Thráin was a Good model, then other Good models cannot make Strikes against him should they beat him in a Combat or make Shooting Attacks if he would be In The Way as with any other Good model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Gandalf's Intervention
active_or_passive_rules.description: If when Thráin takes his Intelligence Test for his Shattered Spirit special rule he is within 3" of a friendly Gandalf the Grey, then he may alter a single dice rolled as part of his Intelligence Test by 1, either up or down. If after this alteration the score of the Intelligence Test is a double, then Thráin may gain the benefits of rolling a double as described in his Shattered Spirit special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Champion Stone Skipper
active_or_passive_rules.description: Baldo may re-roll failed To Hit Rolls when throwing stones. Additionally, if Baldo rolls a natural 6 when rolling To Hit, do not take any In The Way Tests and do not roll To Wound. Baldo's target automatically suffers a Wound

active_or_passive_rules.name: Master of Traps
active_or_passive_rules.description:
At the start of the game, after both sides have deployed, Baldo may place eight 25mm Trap Markers face-down on the board; two each of Snare Traps, Tripwire Traps, Pitfall Traps, and Dummy Traps. These cannot be deployed in the enemy's deployment zone, within 3" of another Trap Marker or an Objective Marker, or within an enemy model's Control Zone. When an enemy model Moves within 1" of a Trap Marker, they immediately stop Moving and flip the Trap Marker; after resolving its effects, the model's Activation immediately ends. Monster, War Beast, Swarm and Chariot models are completely unaffected by Trap Markers, and will instead simply remove them from play if they Move within 1" of them. Once a Trap has been resolved and any affected models are no longer affected, remove that Trap Marker from play. The effects of each Trap Marker are explained below:

Tripwire Trap - When this is revealed, Baldo's player rolls a D6. On a 2+, the model that revealed the trap suffers a Strength 2 hit and is placed Prone. Cavalry models that reveal a trap are only affected on a 4+. However, they will also be Knocked Flying in addition to the other effects.

Pitfall Trap - When this is revealed, Baldo's player rolls a D6. On a 2+, the model that revealed the trap falls into the hole. Whilst in a hole, a model may not Move and always counts as Trapped. If a model begins its Move in a hole they must roll a D6; on a 4+, the model clambers out of the hole and their Move immediately ends. Cavalry models that reveal a trap are only affected on a 4+. However, they will also be Knocked Flying in addition to the other effects.

Snare Trap - When this is revealed, Baldo's player rolls a D6. On a 2+, the model that revealed the trap suffers a Strength 1 hit, is placed Prone and is now caught in the Snare Trap. A model caught in a Snare Trap cannot Activate and will always count as Trapped. During the End Phase, a model caught in a Snare Trap must roll a D6; if the roll is equal to or less than their Strength, then they are freed from the Snare Trap. Cavalry models that reveal a trap are only affected on a 4+. However, they will also be Knocked Flying in addition to the other effects.

Dummy Trap - When this is revealed, the Activation of the model that revealed the Trap Marker immediately ends. There are no additional effects.

active_or_passive_rules.description: This model treats friendly Bear models as a banner.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pitchfork

active_or_passive_rules.description: Whenever a friendly Druadan model within 6" of Ghan-buri-Ghan that is within a piece of woodland terrain suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Head Shirriff
active_or_passive_rules.description: Holfoot, and any Hobbit Shirriffs (including Robin Smallburrow) within 3" of him, do not suffer the -1 penalty to their Duel Roll for using their hand-and-a-half weapon as a two-handed weapon.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Family Rivalry
active_or_passive_rules.description: Lotho may not take part in any Heroic Actions declared by either Bilbo Baggins or Frodo Baggins.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Considerable Wealth
active_or_passive_rules.description:
Lotho may spend his Will Points to pay off models around him in the following ways:

At the start of a Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Lotho can spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, until the End Phase of the turn, friendly Hobbit models within 3" of Lotho gain a +1 bonus to their Fight Value.

At the start of a Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Lotho can spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, until the End Phase of the turn, friendly Ruffian models within 3" of Lotho count as having the Fearless special rule.

When an enemy model attempts to Charge Lotho, Lotho may spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, roll a D6. On a 2+, the enemy model stops 1" away from Lotho instead of Charging him and their Activation immediately ends.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Horn of the Riddermark
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, Merry gains the Fearless special rule.

additional_text: Any Hobbit Militia in Merry's Warband upgraded to Battlin' Brandybucks have Strength 3.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Against all odds
active_or_passive_rules.description: Pippin may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes against Hero or Monster models.

additional_text: Any Hobbit Archers in Pippin's Warband upgraded to Tookish Hunters may re-roll To Wounds of a 1 when making shooting attacks.

active_or_passive_rules.name: River-daughter
active_or_passive_rules.description: Goldberry treats all kinds of terrain as Open Ground and always treats the result of any Climb, Leap, Jump and Swim Tests as a 6. Goldberry cannot be targeted by any abilities, special rules, Magical Powers, Brutal Power Attacks or shooting attacks, either friendly or enemy. This means that any Magical Powers that would target Goldberry will automatically be resisted, even if they would target multiple models. If Goldberry is hit by a missile weapon as a result of a failed In The Way Test, the shot will automatically disappear and have no effect. Goldberry does not have a Control Zone. Enemy models cannot Move into base contact with Goldberry for any reason, unless Goldberry's controlling player explicitly allows it. If a model would be forced into base contact with Goldberry, then they will stop just before moving into base contact. Goldberry may Charge enemy models as normal, and her side will automatically win any Combat that Goldberry is involved in; however, when they do, friendly models may not make Strikes in that Combat. Goldberry may never carry Objectives under any circumstances, and may never be chosen in Scenarios that require a player to choose a specific Hero model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Goldberry is waiting
active_or_passive_rules.description: Goldberry may only be included in your Army if it includes Tom Bombadil. Goldberry must give up a Will Point during the End Phase of any turn in which she was Engaged in Combat. Should Goldberry be reduced to 0 Will Points, or if there are no friendly models on the board other than herself and/or Tom Bombadil, then she will simply wander off back to her homestead. Remove Goldberry as a casualty.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Sing a Jolly Song (Goldberry)
active_or_passive_rules.description:
At any point during her Activation, Goldberry may spend a Will Point to sing one of the songs listed below to gain the relevant effect. Goldberry may sing any number of these songs during her Activation, and may sing each of these songs as many times as she wishes during her Activation unless otherwise stated. Every time Goldberry sings a song it will cost her a Will Point.

"Supper is Ready" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Goldberry. The chosen model immediately regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. A model may only be chosen by this song once per turn.

"Have Peace Now" - Choose an enemy model within 6" of Goldberry. The chosen model may not be Activated during their player's Activation Phase this turn, but may otherwise act normally in all other Phases. This song may only be sung once per turn.

"Heed no Nightly Noises" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Goldberry. Until the end of the turn, the chosen model automatically passes any Courage Tests it is required to take. Additionally, if the chosen model Charges an enemy model, the chosen model will increase their Fight Value by 1 until the End Phase of the turn. A model may only be chosen by this song once per turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: A Nose for Shortcuts
active_or_passive_rules.description: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or ones where you roll to see which part of the board you deploy a Warband in (though not when rolling to choose deployment zones), you may choose the result instead of rolling, even if Robin is not on the battlefield. Robin may only use this special rule if his Warband only contains Hobbit Shirriffs.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Sting
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Sting.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "There's some good in this world, Mr Frodo, and it's worth fighting for"
active_or_passive_rules.description: During the Declare Heroic Actions step of the Fight Phase, if Frodo and/or Rosie are Engaged in Combat and are within 6" of Sam, then Sam may declare a free Heroic Combat. If this Heroic Combat is successful, then Sam must use the following Move to join either Frodo's or Rosie's Combat, as chosen by Sam's controlling player. If this is not possible, then Sam must Move as close as possible to either Frodo or Rosie. Sam cannot use this special rule if he is in the same Combat as either Frodo or Rosie.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Tom is Master
active_or_passive_rules.description: Tom Bombadil treats all kinds of terrain as Open Ground and always treats the result of any Climb, Leap, Jump and Swim Tests as a 6. Tom cannot be targeted by any abilities, special rules, Magical Powers, Brutal Power Attacks or shooting attacks, either friendly or enemy. This means that any Magical Powers that would target Tom will automatically be resisted, even if they would target multiple models. If Tom is hit by a missile weapon as a result of a failed In The Way Test, the shot will automatically disappear and have no effect. Tom Bombadil does not have a Control Zone. Enemy models cannot Move into base contact with Tom for any reason, unless Tom's controlling player explicitly allows it. If a model would be forced into base contact with Tom, then they will stop just before moving into base contact. Tom may Charge enemy models as normal, and his side will automatically win any Combat that Tom is involved in; however, when they do, friendly models may not make Strikes in that Combat. Tom Bombadil may never carry Objectives under any circumstances, and may never be chosen in Scenarios that require a player to choose a specific Hero model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Tom has his house to mind
active_or_passive_rules.description: Tom Bombadil must give up a Will Point during the End Phase of any turn in which he was Engaged in Combat. Should Tom be reduced to 0 Will Points, or if there are no friendly models on the board other than himself and/or Goldberry, then he will simply wander off back to his homestead. Remove Tom Bombadil as a casualty.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Sing a Jolly Song (Tom)
active_or_passive_rules.description:
At any point during his Activation, Tom may spend a Will Point to sing one of the songs listed below to gain the relevant effect. Tom may sing any number of these songs during his Activation, and may sing each of these songs as many times as he wishes during his Activation unless otherwise stated. Every time Tom sings a song it will cost him a Will Point.

"Hey! Come Merry Doll!" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Tom Bombadil. The chosen model immediately regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. A model may only be chosen by this song once per turn.

"Hop along, my hearties!" - Until the end of the turn, friendly models that begin their Activation within 6" of Tom Bombadil may add 3" to their Move Value and will treat all areas of Difficult Terrain as Open Ground. A model may only be affected by this song once per turn.

"Wake now my merry lads!" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Tom Bombadil. The chosen model immediately recovers from the effects of any enemy Magical Powers currently cast upon them. Additionally, until the end of the turn, the chosen model cannot be chosen as the target of any enemy Magical Powers or special rules.

"Ring a dong dillo!" - Until the end of the turn, friendly models within 6" of Tom Bombadil automatically pass any Courage Tests they are required to take.

"Get out, you Wight!" - Choose an enemy Spirit model within 6" of Tom Bombadil. The chosen model immediately suffers a Wound. This song may only be sung once per turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Mayor of Michel Delving
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the beginning of a Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Will Whitfoot can spend a Will Point to use this special rule. If he does, friendly Hobbit Warrior models within 3" of him gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value until the End Phase of the turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Live to fight another day
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Fredegar attempts to Charge an enemy model with the Terror special rule and fails the Courage Test, then Fredegar may still Move as normal; however, he may not Charge any model that turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: To me, Shire-folk!
active_or_passive_rules.description: Paladin's Stand Fast has a range of 12"; however, only friendly Hobbit models may benefit from Paladin's Stand Fast.

active_or_passive_rules.name: For Tuckborough!
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Tookish Hunters within 6" of Paladin gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

additional_text: Any Hobbit Archers in Paladin's Warband upgraded to Tookish Hunters may re-roll To Wounds of a 1 when making shooting attacks.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Easterling Halberd
active_or_passive_rules.description: This can be used as either a pike or a two-handed weapon.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Phalanx
active_or_passive_rules.description: A model with this special rule can use a pike and a shield at the same time without penalty. Additionally, should an Infantry model with this special rule lose a Combat, up to two friendly models with this special rule can Make Way instead of one.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Easterling Halberd
active_or_passive_rules.description: This can be used as either a pike or a two-handed weapon.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Phalanx
active_or_passive_rules.description: A model with this special rule can use a pike and a shield at the same time without penalty. Additionally, should an Infantry model with this special rule lose a Combat, up to two friendly models with this special rule can Make Way instead of one.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Orcish Brawler
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Gorbag is outnumbered in a Combat, he increases his Attacks to 3 for the duration of the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Adaptive Fighter
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Gorbag wins a Duel Roll, then before models Back Away Gorbag may choose a single enemy model involved in the combat. The chosen model is Backed Away in a direction chosen by Gorbag. This direction may be chosen so that the model is forced to Back Away over the edge of a cliff, in which case they will suffer falling damage as normal. Once this has been resolved, other models Back Away as normal and Strikes are resolved. However, if a model has been Backed Away over the edge of a cliff as described earlier, Gorbag cannot make Strikes against that model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Gothmog's Right Hand
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Gothmog's Enforcer is within 3" of Gothmog, then Gothmog can spend Gothmog's Enforcer's Will Points to declare a Heroic Move or Heroic March instead of using his own Might Points. Additionally, when Gothmog declares a Heroic Move or Heroic March within 3" of Gothmog's Enforcer, Gothmog can measure the range of the With Me or At the Double from Gothmog's Enforcer rather than himself if he wishes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "The time of the Orc has come"
active_or_passive_rules.description: Once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, Gothmog can declare he is using this ability. Until the end of the turn, friendly Mordor Orc models within 12" of Gothmog may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "The Age of Men is Over"
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Mordor Orc models within 3" of Gothmog gain the Hatred (Man) special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Master of Reserves
active_or_passive_rules.description: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or ones where you roll to see which part of the board you deploy a Warband in (though not when rolling to choose deployment zones), you may modify the roll for Guritz's Warband by +1 or -1, even if he is not on the battlefield. If Guritz is on the battlefield, you may also modify the roll for other Warbands in your Army by +1 or -1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: End the Race of Man
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: End the Race of Man
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: End the Race of Man
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Whip of the Masters
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whenever a friendly Hero model within 6" declares a Heroic Move, Heroic March or Heroic Shoot, roll a D6. On a 4+ the Hero does not spend the Might Point and the Heroic Action is free.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Cleaving Blow
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Cleaving Blow
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Severed Heads
active_or_passive_rules.description: If a Mordor War Catapult chooses to fire Severed Heads, determine the actual target as normal. Then, instead of rolling To Wound, the actual target and any enemy model within 3" of them must each take a Courage Test. If the test is failed, the model flees and is removed as a casualty.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Flaming Ammunition
active_or_passive_rules.description: A Siege Engine upgraded with Flaming Ammunition may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls against a Siege Target.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Troll Loader
active_or_passive_rules.description: If the Mordor Siege Troll is one of the models firing the Mordor War Catapult this turn, then the Mordor Siege Catapult may re-roll the To Hit Roll.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Area Effect
active_or_passive_rules.description: After rolling To Hit against the actual target, if the actual target was a Battlefield Target then all other models within 2" of the actual target suffer a Strength 5 hit and, if they survive, will be knocked Prone.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Wall-breaker
active_or_passive_rules.description: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, a Mordor War Catapult makes 2 To Wound Rolls and picks the highest. Additionally, a successful To Wound Roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.

additional_text: Crewed by three Mordor Orc Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran, and a Mordor Siege Troll.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Sense of Impending Doom
active_or_passive_rules.description: Enemy models within 6" of the Mouth of Sauron cannot re-roll 1s as part of a Duel Roll, regardless of special rules that would normally allow them to.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Morgul Blade
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a hand weapon. Once per game, a model with a Morgul Blade can use it during a Combat instead of their normal hand weapon; this must be declared before Strikes are made. If they do, all their Strikes must be resolved against a single enemy model, and if the target suffers a Wound that is not prevented in some way, they will immediately lose all remaining Wounds and be removed as a casualty. If the model using the Morgul Blade is mounted, they must use the Strength and Attacks of the rider rather than their Mount.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Hands off the shiny shirt, that's mine!
active_or_passive_rules.description: During a Scenario that involves picking up and carrying Objectives, Shagrat can use this special rule at any point during his Move. If he does, he may select any friendly model within 3" that is carrying an Objective and take an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, Shagrat immediately gains possession of that Objective, even if the Scenario would not normally allow for that Objective to be passed. Additionally, Shagrat can always carry multiple Objectives, even if the Scenario would state that models can only carry one.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Cleaving Blow
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lone Hunter
active_or_passive_rules.description: Shelob may never be included in another model's Warband. Additionally, Shelob can never benefit from the Heroic Actions of other models.

active_or_passive_rules.name: She is always hungry
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the start of her Activation, so long as she is not Engaged in Combat, Shelob can choose to kill a friendly model within 1" of her - remove the chosen model as a casualty. If she does, until the end of the turn Shelob may re-roll a single dice during any Duel Roll she participates in.

active_or_passive_rules.name: She hungers for sweeter meats
active_or_passive_rules.description: Shelob adds 1 to her Attacks characteristic whilst she is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man, Elf, Dwarf or Hobbit model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Caught in a Web
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of making Strikes, Shelob may instead choose a single enemy model that was involved in the Combat. The chosen model immediately suffers a single Strength 8 hit and, if it survives, will be subject to the Paralyse Magical Power - however, the model will not automatically recover should Shelob be removed as a casualty, leave the board or be reduced to 0 Will Points.

active_or_passive_rules.name: A Fell Light is in Them
active_or_passive_rules.description:
At the end of this model's Move, it can choose a single enemy model within 12" and Line of Sight. The chosen model must take an Intelligence Test. If the test is failed, you may Move the chosen model up to its Move Value directly towards this model, even if it has already Moved that turn.

The chosen model will stop Moving if it would enter the Control Zone of an enemy model (with the exception of this model), if it comes into contact with an Obstacle, another model (though they will never count as Charging in this instance, and therefore cannot be involved in Combat with the model) or piece of impassable terrain, or if the model reaches the edge of a cliff or other such edge that would cause it to take falling damage.

This Move cannot be used to Move a model out of Combat, make a model dismount, drop an item or Lie Down. However, if this Move would allow the chosen model to Charge this model, then this model may make them Charge. A model affected by this special rule cannot Move any further that turn, and may not use Active abilities.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Lord of the Rings
active_or_passive_rules.description: Sauron gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The One Ring
active_or_passive_rules.description: Sauron does not follow the normal rules for the One Ring. Instead, each time Sauron would lose his last Wound and be removed as a casualty, roll a D6. On a 2+, the power of the One Ring sustains him and instead of being removed as a casualty he will remain on the board with 1 Wound remaining. If during a Combat Sauron suffers multiple Wounds that would cause him to be removed as a casualty, he will make this roll for each of them. Sauron may use Might to improve this roll.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Unstoppable!
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of making Strikes, Sauron can instead make a single Strength 8 hit on every enemy model involved in the Combat, and one Strength 8 hit on every model Supporting a model involved in the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Flames of Evil
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of making Strikes, Sauron may instead choose a single enemy model involved in the Combat. The chosen model immediately suffers a single Strength 10 hit and, if they survive, will be Set Ablaze and knocked Prone.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Morgul Blade
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a hand weapon. Once per game, a model with a Morgul Blade can use it during a Combat instead of their normal hand weapon; this must be declared before Strikes are made. If they do, all their Strikes must be resolved against a single enemy model, and if the target suffers a Wound that is not prevented in some way, they will immediately lose all remaining Wounds and be removed as a casualty. If the model using the Morgul Blade is mounted, they must use the Strength and Attacks of the rider rather than their Mount.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Crown of Morgul
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Whilst wearing the Crown of Morgul, enemy models within 6" of the Witch-king, or attempting to Charge the Witch-king, cannot benefit from special rules that would allow them to automatically pass Courage Tests, with the exception of Heroic Resolve. Additionally, once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, the Witch-king can imbue its great power to ignite his hand weapon - until the end of the turn, any model that suffers a Wound from a Strike made by the Witch-king is Set Ablaze.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Visage of Terror
active_or_passive_rules.description: If an enemy model attempts to Charge this model and fails its Courage Test as a result of the Terror special rule, then their Activation will immediately end rather than them just not being able to Move that turn. Models affected by this special rule cannot Shoot in the Shoot Phase, and cannot Move in the Fight Phase if part of a successful Heroic Combat, but may otherwise act normally in those phases.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Visage of Terror
active_or_passive_rules.description: If an enemy model attempts to Charge this model and fails its Courage Test as a result of the Terror special rule, then their Activation will immediately end rather than them just not being able to Move that turn. Models affected by this special rule cannot Shoot in the Shoot Phase, and cannot Move in the Fight Phase if part of a successful Heroic Combat, but may otherwise act normally in those phases.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Flaming Ammunition
active_or_passive_rules.description: A Siege Engine upgraded with Flaming Ammunition may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls against a Siege Target.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Accurate
active_or_passive_rules.description: A Mordor Siege Bow will only Scatter 3" rather than 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: Piercing Shot
active_or_passive_rules.description: A model that is hit by the shot of a Mordor Siege Bow will be flung back D6" directly away from the Siege Bow if it has a Strength of 5 or lower. Any model that is passed over by the flung model suffers a Strength 5 hit and will be knocked Prone. If the flung model comes into contact with a piece of impassable terrain or a model with a Strength of 6 or higher, then it will stop and both the flung model and the model or piece of terrain that was hit will suffer one Strength 6 hit. After being flung back, the flung model will be knocked Prone if they survive. If after the model is flung back it would finish over other models and it has survived, then simply move other models the minimum distance possible to allow the flung model to be placed where it has landed.

additional_text: Crewed by three Mordor Orc Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Visage of Terror
active_or_passive_rules.description: If an enemy model attempts to Charge this model and fails its Courage Test as a result of the Terror special rule, then their Activation will immediately end rather than them just not being able to Move that turn. Models affected by this special rule cannot Shoot in the Shoot Phase, and cannot Move in the Fight Phase if part of a successful Heroic Combat, but may otherwise act normally in those phases.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Kingdoms of Men
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model's Stand Fast is increased to 12" and will affect friendly Dale Hero models.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Ring of Barahir
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Whenever Aragorn is affected by a Magical Power, after any Resist Tests have been made (if able), he may roll a D6. On a natural 6, Aragorn is not affected by that Magical Power.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Anduril, Flame of the West
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. Whenever Aragorn makes Strikes with Andúril, he never requires more than a 4+ when rolling To Wound. If Aragorn uses Andúril as a two-handed weapon, then he will still gain the bonus of +1 when rolling To Wound, meaning he will Wound on a 3+.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "Stand, Men of the West"
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly models treat Aragorn, King Elessar as a banner with a range of 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: Horn of Gondor
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique war horn. At the start of a Combat involving Boromir, if he is outnumbered in the Combat then he may blow the Horn of Gondor. If he does, then one enemy model involved in the Combat (chosen by their controlling player) must take a Courage Test. If the Courage Test is passed then the Combat is fought as normal. If the Courage Test is failed then no Duel Roll is made and Boromir automatically wins the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Banner of Minas Tirith
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique banner with a range of 6". Boromir does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel Roll for carrying a banner. Additionally, if a friendly Gondor Warrior model within range of the Banner of Minas Tirith is involved in a Drawn Combat, and the Combat is tied at the Gondor Warrior model's Fight Value (i.e., both sides have Fight Value 4 as their highest), then instead of rolling off to see who wins, the Gondor Warrior model wins instead. If both sides have a similar special rule, roll off as normal.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Son of Gondor
active_or_passive_rules.description: In a turn in which he Charges, Boromir gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Well-aimed Shot
active_or_passive_rules.description: When making a shooting attack, the first time Damrod fails an In The Way Roll he may make an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, the In The Way Roll will be successful instead.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Broken Mind
active_or_passive_rules.description: During each Priority Phase, after Priority has been determined, Denethor must take an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, all is fine and Denethor acts as normal. If the test is failed, then during this turn Denethor is controlled by the opposing player and will be Activated during that player's Activation Phase as if he is one of their models, and may even Charge and fight models from his own Army. When Denethor is Activated by the opposing player he is still considered to be a friendly model, and so friendly models cannot target him with shooting attacks or Magical Powers that cause damage, and may not make Strikes against him if they beat him in a Combat. When Denethor is under the control of the opposing player, they cannot use any of Denethor's Might, Will or Fate Points. Even when under the control of the opposing player, Denethor always counts as a model in his controlling player's Army. If Boromir is part of the same Army, then Denethor will automatically pass this Intelligence Test so long as Boromir is alive. However, should Boromir be slain, then Denethor will automatically fail the next Intelligence Test he has to make for this special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Narsil
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Master-forged two-handed weapon. Additionally, a model wielding Narsil may declare a Heroic Combat during each Fight Phase for free.

active_or_passive_rules.name: High King of Gondor and Arnor
active_or_passive_rules.description: The range of Elendil's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: "A Chance for Faramir, Captain of Gondor to show his Quality"
active_or_passive_rules.description: Should Faramir's Army be Broken, then from that point onwards Faramir may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes. Additionally, should Faramir's Army be Broken, then Faramir may declare a Heroic Resolve each turn for free.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Wizard's Pupil
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Faramir is alive and on the battlefield, if you win the roll to choose who has Priority, and choose to give Priority to your opponent, then until the end of the turn Faramir and friendly Warrior models within 3" of him gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pippin
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Gandalf is upgraded to take Pippin, then Pippin will be treated as a Passenger on Shadowfax. Pippin uses the Peregrin Took, Guard of the Citadel profile (see page 54) and will always count as an Independent Hero in this instance. Pippin will still count as a model towards the Army's total number of models and Break Point, though will not take up a space in Gandalf's Warband. Whilst Pippin is mounted on Shadowfax, Gandalf gains the Resistant to Magic special rule, may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes, and can spend Pippin's Might, Will and Fate Points as if they were his own.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Glamdring
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Glamdring.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Narya
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Gandalf may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Flaming Ammunition
active_or_passive_rules.description: A Siege Engine upgraded with Flaming Ammunition may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls against a Siege Target.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Area Effect
active_or_passive_rules.description: After rolling To Hit against the actual target, if the actual target was a Battlefield Target then all other models within 2" of the actual target suffer a Strength 5 hit and, if they survive, will be knocked Prone.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Wall-breaker
active_or_passive_rules.description: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, a Gondor Battlecry Trebuchet makes 2 To Wound Rolls and picks the highest. Additionally, a successful To Wound Roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.

additional_text: Crewed by three Minas Tirith Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Protectors of the White Tree
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model is within 6" of a friendly Gondor General, it is treated as having the Dominant (2) special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pennant of the Dead
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Dunharrow models within 3" of a model with a Pennant of the Dead count as having the Resistant to Magic special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The King's Counsel
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst the King of the Dead is within 3" of this model, the King of the Dead can spend this model's Will Points to declare a Heroic Action instead of spending one of his own Might Points.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Defend the White City
active_or_passive_rules.description: Irolas may use the Shielding special rule even though he is not armed with a shield. If Irolas elects to shield, and wins the ensuing Combat, he may make a single Strike against one enemy model that was involved in the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Captain of the Citadel Guard
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Citadel Guard within 3" of Irolas gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Shards of Narsil
active_or_passive_rules.description: If your Army also contains Elendil, then if Elendil is slain, place a 25mm Marker where he was killed. If Isildur ends his Activation within 1" of this Marker, he may gain the Shards of Narsil - remove the Marker. The Shards of Narsil are a Unique hand weapon, and a model fighting with it in Combat gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Drain Soul
active_or_passive_rules.description: A model that suffers a Wound from the King of the Dead in Combat, which is not then prevented, will automatically have their Wounds reduced to 0, causing them to be slain and removed as a casualty.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Dead and the Living
active_or_passive_rules.description: Only friendly Dunharrow models may benefit from the King of the Dead's Stand Fast or benefit from his Heroic Actions.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Master of Reserves
active_or_passive_rules.description: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or ones where you roll to see which part of the board you deploy a Warband in (though not when rolling to choose deployment zones), you may modify the roll for Madril's Warband by +1 or -1, even if he is not on the battlefield. If Madril is on the battlefield, you may also modify the roll for other Warbands in your Army by +1 or -1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Loyal to the Captains
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model is within 6" or Boromir or Faramir, they may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Chief of Lamedon
active_or_passive_rules.description: Other friendly Lamedon models within 3" of Angbor automatically pass any Courage Tests they are required to take.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Axe of Lossarnach
active_or_passive_rules.description: An Axe of Lossarnach can be used either as a spear or a two-handed weapon.

active_or_passive_rules.name: An Unlikely Friendship
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of a friendly Pippin, Beregond may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Dead-eye Shot
active_or_passive_rules.description: When benefiting from a Heroic Shoot, this model may re-roll failed To Wound rolls when making shooting attacks.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pride of Dol Amroth
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of Prince Imrahil, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Honour of Lamedon
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of a friendly Lamedon Hero model, this model may re-roll any rolls of a natural 1 when making a Duel Roll.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Go for the Eyes!
active_or_passive_rules.description: Duinhir may re-roll failed To Hit Rolls when shooting at an enemy Monster model. Additionally, if Duinhir successfully Wounds an enemy Monster model with a shooting attack (i.e., a Wound is caused and is not prevented), it will deal D3 Wounds rather than 1.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lord of the Blackroot Vale
active_or_passive_rules.description: Other friendly Blackroot Vale models within 3" of Duinhir may re-roll To Hit Rolls of a 1 when making a shooting attack in the Shoot Phase, provided they did not Move in the preceding Move Phase.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Horn of Lossarnach
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, once per game at the beginning of his Activation, Forlong may let out a blast on his horn. If he does, then friendly models within 12" of Forlong count as having the Terror special rule until the end of the turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lord of Lossarnach
active_or_passive_rules.description: Other friendly Lossarnach models within 3" of Forlong the Fat may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Swift Reload
active_or_passive_rules.description: When firing the Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower, you may roll two dice and pick the highest result when determining how many shots it may make.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Rapid Fire
active_or_passive_rules.description: A Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower doesn't shoot like a normal Siege Engine. Instead, it may make D6 shooting attacks in the same way as a normal Missile Weapon. No Scatter is required for these shots; they will either hit or miss. Each shot may be fully resolved before determining the target of the next one. Shots fired by a Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower do not kill their targets outright if they Wound them.

additional_text: Crewed by three Minas Tirith Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Warden's Sword
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Master-forged hand-and-a-half weapon.

active_or_passive_rules.name: In Defence of the King
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst he is within 3" of your General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword, Húrin automatically passes any Courage Tests he is required to take and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lines of Command
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst Húrin is alive and on the battlefield, your opponent cannot score any Victory Points for Wounding or slaying the enemy General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Resolute Fighter
active_or_passive_rules.description: Ingold and friendly Gondor Warrior models within 3" of him do not Back Away if they lose a Combat - their opponent must Back Away instead. It is important to note that models benefiting from this special rule can still be Trapped as normal, and a player should check to see if the model would be Trapped under normal circumstances should their side lose the Combat. If they would be Trapped, then opposition models will apply the effects of being Trapped, such as any of their special rules for making Strikes against a Trapped model, and will still make two To Wound Rolls for each Strike as they would against any other Trapped model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pride of Dol Amroth
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of Prince Imrahil, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Lineage of Numenor
active_or_passive_rules.description: The range of Prince Imrahil's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: Dol Amroth for Gondor!
active_or_passive_rules.description: Other friendly Dol Amroth models treat Prince Imrahil as a banner with a range of 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: Hadhafang
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. Additionally, a model wielding Hadhafang gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against a Spirit model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Lord of Lorien
active_or_passive_rules.description: Celeborn gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Battle Wisdom
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Lothlórien Warrior models within 3" of Celeborn gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

additional_text: Any Galadhrim Warriors upgraded to Lorien Guard in Celeborn's warband may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Shipwright's Power
active_or_passive_rules.description: Círdan gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Hadhafang
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. Additionally, a model wielding Hadhafang gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against a Spirit model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Vilya
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Elrond may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lord of the West
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll. Additionally, they may re-roll a single D6 when rolling To Wound when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Foresight of the Eldar
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the start of the game, before either side deploys, roll a D6 and make a note of the result - this is the number of Foresight Points that Elrond has for the battle. During the roll for Priority, so long as he is alive and on the battlefield, Elrond can spend these Foresight Points to increase the roll on his controlling player's roll for Priority. For each Foresight Point spent, increase the dice roll by 1, to a maximum of 6.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Nenya
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Galadriel may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Lady of Lothlorien
active_or_passive_rules.description: Galadriel gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Mirror of Galadriel
active_or_passive_rules.description: The Mirror of Galadriel is a Heavy Object on a 40mm base, and has a Defence of 8 and 3 Wounds. It is deployed within 6" of Galadriel at the start of the game, though for Scenarios in which models Move onto the board it can be carried onto the battlefield by two friendly models. During the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has happened, if Galadriel or Celeborn is in base contact with the Mirror of Galadriel, then their controlling player may add 1 to their roll for Priority. Additionally, during the End Phase of each turn, one friendly Hero within 6" of the Mirror of Galadriel may restore their Fate Points to their starting value.

additional_text: Any Galadhrim Warriors upgraded to Lorien Guard in Galadriel's warband may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Aiglos
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven spear. Additionally, a model wielding Aiglos gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: High King of the Elves
active_or_passive_rules.description: The range of Gil-galad's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6". Additionally, friendly Elf Hero models may benefit from Gil-galad's Stand Fast.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Lord of the West
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll. Additionally, they may re-roll a single D6 when rolling To Wound when making Strikes.

additional_text: Any Rivendell Warriors upgraded to King's Guard in Gil-Galad's warband will have a Fight value of 6.

active_or_passive_rules.name: One Final Blow
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Haldir is slain in Combat, he may immediately make a single Strength 4 Strike on each enemy model that was involved in the Combat in which Haldir was slain. Haldir may use Might to increase these To Wound Rolls as normal.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Song of Elbereth
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Rivendell models within 3" of Lindir gain the Resistant to Magic special rule.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Wise Council
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Elrond is within 6" of Lindir at the start of a turn, then Elrond gains a free Will Point for the turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Wood Elf spear
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is an Elven spear. Additionally, a model armed with a Wood Elf Spear may use the Shielding rule even though they do not have a shield.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Orcrist
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. Orcrist has the Orcbane, Goblinbane and Uruk-haibane special rules. Additionally, the wielder of Orcrist has the Terror (Orc), Terror (Goblin) and Terror (Uruk-hai) special rules.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Deadly Shot
active_or_passive_rules.description: Legolas may make three shooting attacks during the Shoot Phase instead of one, using all the normal rules for shooting. Additionally, Legolas may still make shooting attacks whilst he is Engaged in Combat if there are no other friendly models engaged in the same combat, and does not suffer the -1 penalty To Hit for Moving and Shooting so long as he has the Infantry keyword. If Legolas shoots whilst he is Engaged in Combat, he may shoot at enemy models he is Engaged in Combat with, and does not need to make In The Way Tests for shooting at models he is Engaged in Combat with (though they may still block Line of Sight as normal).

active_or_passive_rules.name: Pinpoint Shot
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas may make a single shooting attack against an enemy model Engaged in Combat with a friendly model (including himself). If he does, then if the To Hit Roll is successful, Legolas doesn't need to make any In The Way Rolls - the shot will automatically hit its target.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Elven Glaive
active_or_passive_rules.description: This is an Elven spear. Additionally, a model armed with this weapon that is Engaged in Combat and is not being Supported may either gain a bonus of +1 Attacks for their Duel Roll, or +1 Attacks when making Strikes. This must be decided before the Duel Roll takes place.

active_or_passive_rules.name: King's Knights
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst they have the Cavalry keyword, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value and +1 to their Defence whilst within 6" of Thranduil.

Additionally, a model armed with this weapon that is Engaged in Combat and is not being Supported may either gain a bonus of +1 Attacks for their Duel Roll, or +1 Attacks when making Strikes. This must be decided before the Duel Roll takes place.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Knife Fighters
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Outnumbered in Combat, then before making their Duel roll, this model gains +1 Attack for each model they are Engaged in Combat with, after the first, up to the a maximum of 3 bonus Attacks. This bonus lasts until the end of the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Knife Fighters
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Outnumbered in Combat, then before making their Duel roll, this model gains +1 Attack for each model they are Engaged in Combat with, after the first, up to the a maximum of 3 bonus Attacks. This bonus lasts until the end of the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: King's Guard
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of Thranduil, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of Thranduil, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Blade Mistress
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Tauriel is Outnumbered in a Combat, then before making her Duel Roll she gains an additional Attack for each model she is Engaged in Combat with after the first. This bonus lasts until the end of the Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Vengeful Fury
active_or_passive_rules.description: If your Army also includes Kíli, and he is removed as a casualty, then Tauriel's Strength is increased to 5 and her Defence reduced to 4 for the remainder of the battle. Additionally, if Kíli is slain, then Tauriel must always Charge an enemy model when she Activates if possible.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Bladelord
active_or_passive_rules.description: If he is Outnumbered in a Combat, Thranduil may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. If he has the Infantry keyword and is Outnumbered in a Combat, Thranduil may instead re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Fury of the Elvenking
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Thranduil is Outnumbered in a Combat, and successfully kills all enemy models that he was Engaged in Combat with, then in the following turn Thranduil may declare a Heroic Combat for free.

active_or_passive_rules.name: "Do not talk to me of Dragon fire"
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the beginning of his Activation, Thranduil can spend a Will Point to use this special rule. If he does, then until the end of the turn Thranduil has the Terror special rule. Additionally, if Thranduil has the Infantry Keyword when he uses this special rule, then each enemy model within 3" of him, that is not Engaged in Combat, must take a Courage Test in an order chosen by Thranduil's controlling player. If the test is failed, they must immediately Move Directly Away from Thranduil as far as they can, up to the limit of their Move Value. Models Moved by this special rule cannot Move again during the turn, but may otherwise act normally.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Unbreakable Bond
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Elrohir is slain, make a note of the model that killed him; for the remainder of the game, Elladan increases his Strength by 1. Additionally, for the remainder of the game, whenever Elladan Activates if he can Charge an enemy model then he must do so; if he is able to Charge the enemy model that killed Elrohir, then he must prioritise that model to Charge. If Elladan is Engaged in Combat with the model that killed Elrohir, and that model is a Hero, he must declare a free Heroic Challenge against them. This may still be done even though Elladan cannot normally declare a Heroic Challenge, and even if the Hero has a lower Heroic Tier than Elladan.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Twin Elven Blades
active_or_passive_rules.description:
Whilst he has the Infantry Keyword, Elladan can choose to fight in one of the three following ways. He must declare which way he is fighting at the start of a Combat, before any dice are rolled:

Elladan can fight with 3 Attacks rather than 2.

Elladan can use his Elven weapons as Elven hand-and-a-half weapons.

Elladan can use his Elven weapons to parry, which counts as Shielding.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Strength of Brotherhood
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst within 3" of Elrohir, Elladan gains the Dominant (2) special rule and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Caras Galadhon Fighting Style
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may use the Shielding rule with their Elven pike. All of the usual rules for Shielding still apply, chiefly that a model using the Shielding rule cannot be Supported by another model, not even another Guard of the Galadhrim Court.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Whirl of Blades
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Orophin rolls a natural 6 in the Duel roll, then he will make double the number of strikes he normally would when rolling To Wound. Note that if the model he is fighting is Trapped, these Strikes will not also gain the benefit for Striking a Trapped model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Swift Parry
active_or_passive_rules.description: Rumil may force one enemy model involved in the same Combat as him to re-roll one D6 in their Duel roll. This must be done before all other re-rolls, and before any Might points are spent.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Enchanting Song
active_or_passive_rules.description:
During their Activation, a Wood Elf Sentinel may sing one of the following songs to gain the relevant effect:

Hymn of Elbereth - Choose a friendly model within 12". Until the End Phase of the turn, the chosen model automatically passes any Courage Tests they are required to take.

Lay of Gondolin - Until the End Phase of the turn, this model and all friendly models within 3" of them gain the Terror special rule.

Eldamar Madrigal - Choose an enemy model within 12" that is not Engaged in Combat; the chosen model must immediately take an Intelligence Test. If the test is failed, then you may immediately Move that model as if it was that model's Activation; however, the only thing they can do is Move. A model made to Move in this manner cannot enter an enemy model's Control Zone, dismount, lie down, be forced to make a Climb, Jump, Leap or Swim Test, and cannot Move in any way that would cause it direct harm (such as attempting to jump off a cliff). A model affected by this song cannot be Activated later in the turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Dunlending Heritage
active_or_passive_rules.description: Friendly Dunland Warrior models within 6" of Freca gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Claim the Throne
active_or_passive_rules.description: If the enemy General is removed as a casualty whilst within 6" of Freca, then for the duration of the battle friendly Dunland models treat Freca as a banner with a range of 6".

active_or_passive_rules.name: Dunlending Commander
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whilst General Targg is alive and on the battlefield, if you win the roll to choose who has Priority, and choose to give Priority to your opponent, then until the end of the turn friendly Dunland Warrior models within 6" of General Targg may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Flaming Brand
active_or_passive_rules.description: A model with a Flaming Brand has the Terror (Cavalry) and Terror (Beast) special rules. Additionally, a model with a Flaming Brand counts as 2 models rather than 1 when working out how many models are within range of an Objective Marker.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Traitor of Rohan
active_or_passive_rules.description: Lord Thorne may only include Rohirrim Traitors in his Warband.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Edoras Shall Fall
active_or_passive_rules.description: During the Fight Phase, friendly Rohirrim Traitors within 6" of Lord Thorne gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Spear Mastery
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may use its throwing spears as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it in either the preceding Move Phase or Shoot Phase.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Orcish Halberd
active_or_passive_rules.description: An Orcish Halberd can be used either as a spear or a two-handed weapon. Additionally, Shank may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes against a Trapped model.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Loot the Bodies
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whenever Shank or Wrot slays a model in Combat, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, they have found a trinket of note and pocketed it. Keep a track of how many trinkets they have found collectively during the course of the game. At the end of the game, so long as at least one of Shank & Wrot are alive, their controlling player gains an additional Victory Point for each trinket they have found, up to a maximum of 5 Victory Points. This can never take Shank's & Wrot's controlling player's total number of Victory Points above 20.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Call 'the Beast'
active_or_passive_rules.description: Shank may spend a Will Point at the start of his Activation to use this ability. If he does, then if the Snow Troll is within 6" of Shank and not Engaged in Combat, then it must Charge during its Activation if possible and, until the end of the turn gains the Fearless special rule and may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Tasty Fingers
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whenever Wrot slays an enemy model in Combat, he may roll a D6. On a 4+, Wrot immediately regains either a Wound or a Fate Point spent earlier in the battle.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Loot the Bodies
active_or_passive_rules.description: Whenever Shank or Wrot slays a model in Combat, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, they have found a trinket of note and pocketed it. Keep a track of how many trinkets they have found collectively during the course of the game. At the end of the game, so long as at least one of Shank & Wrot are alive, their controlling player gains an additional Victory Point for each trinket they have found, up to a maximum of 5 Victory Points. This can never take Shank's & Wrot's controlling player's total number of Victory Points above 20.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Horned Charge
active_or_passive_rules.description: During a turn in which a Snow Troll Charges, it gains a bonus of +1 Attack and +1 to its Fight Value until the end of the turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Usurper King
active_or_passive_rules.description: If Wulf is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero, he may re-roll a single D6 during the Duel Roll. Additionally, Wulf must re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes against an enemy Hero.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Keep 'em for Later
active_or_passive_rules.description: If this model wins a Duel Roll, they may choose a single enemy model on a 25mm base instead of making Strikes or using a Brutal Power Attack. The chosen model is stuffed into a bag and suffers the effects of the Paralyse Magical Power; however, the effects will not immediately end should this model have no Will Points or be slain. If the model is still Paralysed at the end of the game, then they will count as slain and be removed as a casualty.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Roast 'em slowly
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of making Strikes, if he is within 6" of a Campfire, Bert may choose a single enemy model involved in the Combat. The chosen model is then placed in base contact with the Campfire and is immediately Set Ablaze.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Keep 'em for Later

active_or_passive_rules.name: Mince 'em Fine
active_or_passive_rules.description: Instead of making Strikes, Bill may choose a single enemy model involved in the Combat. Bill and the chosen model both roll a D6 and add their respective Strength characteristics. If Bill scores higher after adding Strength characteristics, then the chosen model suffers a number of Wounds equal to the difference between the two scores.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Chittering Hordes
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may Support as if it had a spear, with the exception that they can only Support another model with this special rule. A model Supporting whilst using this special rule cannot also use a two-handed weapon in the same Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Chittering Hordes
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may Support as if it had a spear, with the exception that they can only Support another model with this special rule. A model Supporting whilst using this special rule cannot also use a two-handed weapon in the same Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: The Precious
active_or_passive_rules.description: If your opponent's Army contains a Ringbearer, then when Gollum Moves, he must always Charge the enemy Ringbearer if possible. Additionally, if Gollum kills the enemy Ringbearer in Combat, then he will automatically regain the One Ring - from that point onwards he counts as having it as part of his Wargear.

additional_text: Gollum has strong, strangling fingers and so is never considered to be Unarmed - ever! If your opponent does not have a Ringbearer in their Army, then Gollum carries the One Ring.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Swap with Me
active_or_passive_rules.description: At the start of the Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions Step, Grinnah can choose a friendly Goblin model on a 25mm base within 3" and swap places with it. This does not count as Moving.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Chittering Hordes
active_or_passive_rules.description: This model may Support as if it had a spear, with the exception that they can only Support another model with this special rule. A model Supporting whilst using this special rule cannot also use a two-handed weapon in the same Combat.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Relentless Advance
active_or_passive_rules.description: The Goblin King may Move through friendly Goblin models when he Charges into Combat, though not when forced to Move by the effects of an enemy Magical Power or special rule. Each friendly Goblin model Moved through in this way immediately suffers a Strength 3 hit. The Goblin King may finish his Move overlapping friendly models, through any friendly models he finishes his Move overlapping will automatically be slain.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Goblin Projectile
active_or_passive_rules.description: During the Shoot Phase, if the Goblin King is in base contact with a friendly Goblin model and neither are Engaged in Combat, then the Goblin King can make a shooting attack — this has a range of 12" and counts as a throwing weapon. Remove the friendly Goblin model as a casualty, and then make the To Hit Roll and any In The Way Tests as normal. The shot is resolved at a Strength of 8, and any model that is hit will automatically be knocked Prone.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Blubbery Mass
active_or_passive_rules.description: Each time the Goblin King suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a 3+ the Wound is prevented. Wounds caused by Magical Powers or Elven weapons in Combat ignore this special rule. Wounds caused by Elven missile weapons will cause the Goblin King to suffer a -1 penalty to this roll.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Immobile
active_or_passive_rules.description: The Goblin Scribe cannot Move, and will always count as Trapped should it lose a Duel Roll. Additionally, friendly models may carry the Goblin Scribe in which case it will count as a Heavy Object, and must always be put down after a model carrying it has finished its Move. In Scenarios where models Move onto the board, the Goblin Scribe may be carried on by friendly models.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Always more where they came from
active_or_passive_rules.description: If the Goblin King declares a Heroic Move whilst within 6" of the Goblin Scribe and chooses to call With Me, then it will affect all friendly models on the battlefield rather than just those within 6", and affected models do not have to finish their Activation within 6" of the Goblin King. Additionally, any friendly Goblin Hero that begins their Activation within 3" of the Goblin Scribe can choose to spend a Might Point. If they do, the Goblin King regains a Might Point spent earlier in the battle. This special rule can only be used once per turn.

active_or_passive_rules.name: Keep 'em for Later
